title: NVIDIA Made Me Rich. I'm Buying This Stock Next.
speaker: Alex (Ticker Symbol: YOU)

macro_themes.view: Agents push GPU:CPU ratios down and need far more memory, causing CPU and especially memory shortages.
Memory is shortage-driven through 2027-28, but price increases are slowing and new supply arrives mid-2027 to 2028; memory stocks look cheapest at peaks.

calls.condition: Stop buying if DRAM contract prices go flat or fall while capex keeps rising.
calls.reason: <7x forward earnings vs 17-18x peers implies a ~60% earnings collapse already priced in; a third of revenue contracted with price floors, HBM sold out through 2027, big FCF and buybacks.
calls.quote: my plan for now is to keep buying Micron stock, even though it's already 10x from when I started

calls.condition: Buy only after a big pullback (e.g. after warrant dilution hits) or if earnings growth makes the 45x multiple reasonable.
calls.reason: Great business but >45x forward earnings and up to 16% dilution from OpenAI/Meta warrants make it 'priced basically to perfection'.
calls.quote: I think it's already priced basically to perfection. So, I would only buy AMD stock after a big pullback

notes: No date in transcript; listing approx 2026-10-04. No current share prices quoted (AMD said to be 'already above' $600; at peer multiples AMD would be <$250 and MU >$2,700 — valuation illustrations, not targets). AMD long-term bias = 'great stock to own for the long run' business view; medium neutral reflects 'wait for pullback'.
